VENERABLE_TEA_SET.description: After entering a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], start the next combat with [gold]3 additional Energy[/gold].
FAKE_VENERABLE_TEA_SET.description: After entering a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], start the next combat with [gold]2 additional Energy[/gold].
ETERNAL_FEATHER.description: When entering a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], heal [gold]5 HP[/gold] for every 5 cards in your deck.
GIRYA.description: You may Lift at every [gold]Rest Site[/gold]. Each Lift grants [gold]1 Strength[/gold] at the start of combat, with no total limit.
PUMPKIN_CANDLE.description: Kindle at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold] to gain extra Energy for 5 combats. Kindling while active extends the duration and permanently increases the Energy bonus by 1; the bonus resets when extinguished.
PAELS_GROWTH.description: On pickup, add [gold]Clone[/gold] to a card. At [gold]Rest Sites[/gold], copy every card with Clone; it may be used multiple times per Rest Site according to the mod setting.
MINIATURE_TENT.description: Completing an option at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold] does not force the remaining options to end, allowing additional activities.
REGAL_PILLOW.description: Improves healing when Resting or actively healing a teammate at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
TINY_MAILBOX.description: Gain potion rewards after Resting or actively healing a teammate at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
DREAM_CATCHER.description: Gain a card reward after Resting or actively healing a teammate at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
STONE_HUMIDIFIER.description: Gain [gold]5 Max HP[/gold] after Resting or actively healing a teammate at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
SHOVEL.description: You may Dig at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold] to obtain a relic. After every player finishes, enter an additional normal event valid for the current Act.
